system.description:
EXPERT

You have studied the secretive disciplines of the Night Lotus, whose members combine stealth, anatomy and carefully prepared toxins to incapacitate enemies before they can respond.

Prerequisites Medicine 2 ranks

You gain Medicine as a class skill and gain resistance to poison.

Furthermore, you gain the Night Lotus Venom ability.

NIGHT LOTUS VENOM

FOCUS MANIPULATE POISON TECHNIQUE

Action 1 AP

Requirements You are wielding a piercing or slashing weapon, or a piece of ammunition.

You coat the weapon or ammunition with a fast-acting paralysing toxin. The poison remains effective until the end of your next turn or until the weapon successfully damages a creature.

A creature damaged by the poisoned weapon must make a Fortitude save against your Level DC.

Critical The target is unaffected.

Success The target suffers a -5-foot circumstance penalty to Speed until the beginning of your next turn.

Failure The target is Slowed 1 until the end of its next turn.

Fumble The target is Paralyzed until the beginning of its next turn and is then Slowed 1 until the end of that turn.

If the Strike also inflicts Unseen Assault, the target suffers a -1-circumstance penalty to this saving throw.

After Night Lotus Venom is used, it becomes expended until restored with Refocus.

Progression Requirements Medicine skill +10 ranks

Automated: Medicine is a class skill while you have this feat, and you resist poison. You gain Night Lotus Venom.
